events.note:
From Dennis Lacho's genealogy database:

Obituary appeared in the Winnipeg Free Press on June 14, 1971:
Prayers were said at 8:00 pm, Monday, June 14, 1971 at the Transcona Funeral Chapel, Day Street, Winnipeg, Manitoba. Requiem High Mass was held at 10:00 am, June 15, 1971 at St. Michaels Ukrainian Catholic Church, 400 Day Street, Winnipeg, Manitoba. Rev. Msgr. D. Shewchuk officiated.

Kathereine was survived in 1971 by her daughter Sophie / John Hoshko of Toronto, Ontario, her sons John and Peter of Transcona, 2 grandsons (Michael and Jim Hoshko), one sister in Ukraine, and one brother Stephen in Ukraine. Transcona Funeral Home was in care of arrangements.
